label: Ignore culture opinion
summary: Makes the character ignore the negative opinion they would have of people because of their culture.
details: The game's display name is "No Negative Opinion of Other cultures". Works on a character. Only the negative part is removed.

label: Ignore faith opinion
summary: Makes the character ignore the negative opinion they would have of people because of a different faith.
details: The game's display name is "No Negative Opinion of Other faiths". Works on a character.

label: Inbreeding chance
summary: Changes the chance that the character's children are born with a congenital defect from inbreeding.
details: Works on a character. The game says children of closely related parents risk defects, the worst being the inbred trait. The input does not say whether the amount is flat or a percentage.

label: Independent attacker advantage
summary: Adds a flat amount of battle advantage while the character is independent and the primary attacker in a war.
details: The game text names exactly this condition. The key ends in `_add`, so it is a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Independent defender advantage
summary: Adds a flat amount of battle advantage while the character is independent and the primary defender in a war.
details: The game text names exactly this condition. The key ends in `_add`, so it is a flat amount. Works on a character.

label: Independent ruler opinion
summary: Changes how much independent rulers like the character.
details: Works on a character. The game only names it "Independent Ruler Opinion"; the input does not say whose opinion of whom it changes, or whether the amount is flat.

label: Influence level impact
summary: Changes, by a percentage, how strongly the character's influence level affects them.
details: Works on a character. The game does not say which effects the influence level impact covers. The `_mult` ending means a percentage.

label: Influence gain
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the influence the character gets as rewards.
details: The game's display name is "Influence Rewards". Works on a character. The input does not explain what "standalone" means here.

label: Influence loss
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the influence the character loses.
details: The game's display name is "Influence Loss". Works on a character. The input does not explain what "standalone" means here.

label: Intimidated barter goods
summary: Adds a flat amount to the barter goods that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name ("Intimidated Vassal Barter Goods Base Contribution"). Works on a character.

label: Intimidated barter goods percent
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the barter goods that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name. Works on a character.

label: Intimidated herd
summary: Adds a flat amount to the herd that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name ("Intimidated Vassal Herd Base Contribution"). Works on a character.

label: Intimidated herd percent
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the herd that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name. Works on a character.

label: Intimidated levy
summary: Adds a flat amount to the levy that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name ("Intimidated Vassal Levy Base Contribution"). Works on a character.

label: Intimidated levy percent
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the levy that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name. Works on a character.

label: Intimidated piety
summary: Adds a flat amount to the piety that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name ("Intimidated Vassal Piety Base Contribution"). Works on a character.

label: Intimidated piety percent
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the piety that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name. Works on a character.

label: Intimidated prestige
summary: Adds a flat amount to the prestige that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name ("Intimidated Vassal Prestige Base Contribution"). Works on a character.

label: Intimidated prestige percent
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the prestige that intimidated vassals contribute to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name. Works on a character.

label: Intimidated tax
summary: Adds a flat amount to the tax that intimidated vassals pay to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name ("Intimidated Vassal Tax Base Contribution"). Works on a character.

label: Intimidated tax percent
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the tax that intimidated vassals pay to the character.
details: Going by its name and display name. Works on a character.

label: Intrigue
summary: Adds a flat amount to the character's Intrigue skill.
details: Works on a character. Can be negative. See `intrigue_mult` for the percentage version.

label: Intrigue percent
summary: Changes the character's Intrigue skill by a percentage.
details: Works on a character. It has the same display name as the flat `intrigue` modifier; the `_mult` ending means a percentage.

label: Intrigue per influence level
summary: Adds Intrigue for each influence level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level, so a higher level gives more.

label: Intrigue per merit level
summary: Adds Intrigue for each merit level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level, so a higher level gives more.

label: Intrigue per piety level
summary: Adds Intrigue for each piety level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level, so a higher level gives more.

label: Intrigue per prestige level
summary: Adds Intrigue for each prestige level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level, so a higher level gives more.

label: Intrigue per stress level
summary: Adds Intrigue for each stress level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level. Use a negative value to make stress lower Intrigue.

label: Intrigue scheme speed
summary: Changes how long each phase of the character's Intrigue schemes takes.
details: The game's display name is "Intrigue Scheme Speed". The game says a scheme phase length is counted in days and that a shorter one makes the scheme progress faster. Works on a character. The input does not say whether the value is flat or a percentage.

label: Intrigue scheme resistance
summary: Changes the Intrigue scheme resistance, the value that slows schemes made against the character.
details: The game's display name is "Intrigue Scheme Resistance". The game says resistance lowers the scheme owner's speed. Works on a character. The input does not say how the Intrigue part restricts it.

label: Knight effectiveness
summary: Changes the effectiveness of the character's knights by a percentage.
details: Works on a character. A negative value makes the knights weaker.

label: Knights per Diplomacy
summary: Changes knight effectiveness for each point of the character's Diplomacy skill.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per skill point, so the bonus grows with the skill.

label: Knights per dread
summary: Changes knight effectiveness for each point of the character's dread.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per point of dread.

label: Knights per Intrigue
summary: Changes knight effectiveness for each point of the character's Intrigue skill.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per skill point, so the bonus grows with the skill.

label: Knights per Learning
summary: Changes knight effectiveness for each point of the character's Learning skill.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per skill point, so the bonus grows with the skill.

label: Knights per Martial
summary: Changes knight effectiveness for each point of the character's Martial skill.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per skill point, so the bonus grows with the skill.

label: Knights per Prowess
summary: Changes knight effectiveness for each point of the character's Prowess skill.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per skill point, so the bonus grows with the skill.

label: Knights per Stewardship
summary: Changes knight effectiveness for each point of the character's Stewardship skill.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per skill point, so the bonus grows with the skill.

label: Knights per tyranny
summary: Changes knight effectiveness for each point of the character's tyranny.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per point of tyranny.

label: Knight limit
summary: Changes how many knights the character can have.
details: The game's display name is "Number of Knights". Works on a character. The value is a flat number and can be negative.

label: Learning
summary: Adds a flat amount to the character's Learning skill.
details: Works on a character. Can be negative. See `learning_mult` for the percentage version.

label: Learning percent
summary: Changes the character's Learning skill by a percentage.
details: Works on a character. It has the same display name as the flat `learning` modifier; the `_mult` ending means a percentage.

label: Learning per influence level
summary: Adds Learning for each influence level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level, so a higher level gives more.

label: Learning per merit level
summary: Adds Learning for each merit level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level, so a higher level gives more.

label: Learning per piety level
summary: Adds Learning for each piety level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level, so a higher level gives more.

label: Learning per prestige level
summary: Adds Learning for each prestige level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level, so a higher level gives more.

label: Learning per stress level
summary: Adds Learning for each stress level the character has.
details: Works on a character. The amount is per level. Use a negative value to make stress lower Learning.

label: Learning scheme speed
summary: Changes how long each phase of the character's Learning schemes takes.
details: The game's display name is "Learning Scheme Speed". The game says a scheme phase length is counted in days and that a shorter one makes the scheme progress faster. Works on a character. The input does not say whether the value is flat or a percentage.

label: Learning scheme resistance
summary: Changes the Learning scheme resistance, the value that slows schemes made against the character.
details: The game's display name is "Learning Scheme Resistance". The game says resistance lowers the scheme owner's speed. Works on a character. The input does not say how the Learning part restricts it.

label: Owner-led advantage
summary: Adds a flat amount of battle advantage to armies that are led by their owner.
details: Going by its name; the game gives no display name or description. Vanilla uses it with small whole numbers (1 or 2), e.g. in a court position task. Works on a character.

label: Legitimacy gain
summary: Changes, by a percentage, how much legitimacy the character gains.
details: Works on a character. A negative value lowers the gains.

label: Legitimacy loss
summary: Changes, by a percentage, how much legitimacy the character loses.
details: Works on a character. A negative value makes the losses smaller.

label: Levy damage
summary: Changes the damage the character's levy troops deal in battle.
details: The game's display name is "Levy Damage". Works on a character. The input does not say whether the value is flat or a percentage.

label: Levy maintenance
summary: Changes the cost of keeping the character's levy troops.
details: Works on a character. The input does not say whether the value is flat or a percentage.

label: Levy pursuit
summary: Changes the pursuit of the character's levy troops.
details: Works on a character. The game says pursuit raises the casualties a victorious army inflicts after a battle, by turning routed soldiers into dead ones.

label: Levy reinforcement rate
summary: Changes how fast levy troops are reinforced.
details: Works on a character, a province and a county. The input does not say whether the value is flat or a percentage.

label: Reinforcement, different faith
summary: Changes the levy reinforcement rate in the different-faith case.
details: The game's display name is "Levy Reinforcement Rate (Different faith)". Works on a character. The input does not say which faith is compared with which.

label: Reinforcement, different faith (baron)
summary: Like the different-faith reinforcement rate, and the name says it also applies when the character is only a baron.
details: Its display name is the same as the plain different-faith modifier. The game does not explain what it does for barons in particular. Works on a character.

label: Reinforcement rate (baron)
summary: Like the levy reinforcement rate, and the name says it also applies when the character is only a baron.
details: Its display name is the same as the plain levy reinforcement rate. The game does not explain what it does for barons in particular. Works on a character.

label: Reinforcement, friendly land
summary: Changes the levy reinforcement rate in friendly territory.
details: The game's display name is "Friendly Territory Levy Reinforcement Rate". Works on a character, a province and a county. The input does not say what counts as friendly.

label: Reinforcement, same faith
summary: Changes the levy reinforcement rate in the same-faith case.
details: The game's display name is "Levy Reinforcement Rate (Same faith)". Works on a character. The input does not say which faith is compared with which.

label: Reinforcement, same faith (baron)
summary: Like the same-faith reinforcement rate, and the name says it also applies when the character is only a baron.
details: Its display name is the same as the plain same-faith modifier. The game does not explain what it does for barons in particular. Works on a character.

label: Levy screen
summary: Changes the screen of the character's levy troops.
details: Works on a character. The game says screen lowers the casualties a defeated army takes after a battle.

label: Levy siege progress
summary: Changes how much siege progress the character's levy troops make.
details: Works on a character. The input does not say whether the value is flat or a percentage.

label: Levy size
summary: Changes how many levy troops can be raised.
details: Works on a character, a province and a county. The input does not say whether the value is flat or a percentage.

label: Levy toughness
summary: Changes the toughness of the character's levy troops, which is how much damage a soldier can take before becoming a casualty.
details: Works on a character.

label: Liege opinion
summary: Changes the opinion tied to the liege relation.
details: The game's display name is "Liege Opinion". Works on a character. The input does not say whether it is the liege's opinion of the character or the other way round, or whether the amount is flat.

label: Life expectancy
summary: Changes how many years the character is expected to live.
details: The game's display name marks the unit as years. Works on a character. Can be negative.

label: Long reign bonus
summary: Changes, by a percentage, the Long Reign bonus.
details: Works on a character. The game says Long Reign is an opinion bonus that grows the longer a liege has ruled over a realm's characters.

label: Men-at-arms damage
summary: Adds to the damage the character's men-at-arms deal in battle.
details: Works on a character. It is a flat amount; `maa_damage_mult` is the percentage version.

label: Men-at-arms damage percent
summary: Changes the damage the character's men-at-arms deal by a percentage.
details: Works on a character. It uses the same display name as the flat `maa_damage_add`.

label: Men-at-arms pursuit
summary: Adds to the pursuit of the character's men-at-arms.
details: Works on a character. It is a flat amount; `maa_pursuit_mult` is the percentage version. The game says pursuit raises the casualties a victorious army inflicts after a battle.

label: Men-at-arms pursuit percent
summary: Changes the pursuit of the character's men-at-arms by a percentage.
details: Works on a character. It uses the same display name as the flat `maa_pursuit_add`.

label: Men-at-arms screen
summary: Adds to the screen of the character's men-at-arms.
details: Works on a character. It is a flat amount; `maa_screen_mult` is the percentage version. The game says screen lowers the casualties a defeated army takes after a battle.

label: Men-at-arms screen percent
summary: Changes the screen of the character's men-at-arms by a percentage.
details: Works on a character. It uses the same display name as the flat `maa_screen_add`.

label: Men-at-arms siege progress
summary: Adds to the siege progress made by the character's men-at-arms.
details: Works on a character. It is a flat amount; `maa_siege_value_mult` is the percentage kind.

label: Siege weapon effectiveness
summary: Changes, by a percentage, how effective the character's men-at-arms siege weapons are.
details: Works on a character. Its display name differs from the flat `maa_siege_value_add`: it speaks of siege weapon effectiveness, not siege progress.

label: Men-at-arms toughness
summary: Adds to the toughness of the character's men-at-arms, which is how much damage a soldier can take before becoming a casualty.
details: Works on a character. It is a flat amount; `maa_toughness_mult` is the percentage version.

label: Men-at-arms toughness percent
summary: Changes the toughness of the character's men-at-arms by a percentage.
details: Works on a character. It uses the same display name as the flat `maa_toughness_add`.

label: Martial
summary: Adds a flat amount to the character's Martial skill.
details: Works on a character. Can be negative.
